spine: 1. 2026 年 6 月 24 日，研究者 Konstantinos Maninakis 回報 Radicle 節點間的網路流量完全沒有加密，handshake 做完後直接明文傳輸。
2. 2026 年 8 月 12 日，另一位研究者 cryptocode 回報第二個獨立問題：連線 handshake 的身分驗證是壞的，任何人都能宣稱自己是任一 Node ID。
3. 研究者的封包分析與上游 GitHub issue 顯示根因：程式碼把 Noise handshake 完成跟 SOCKS5 proxy 協商完成共用同一個 is_complete() 判斷式，該加密的資料因此被當明文直接穿透。（post 順序：此點先於下一點出現，在 H2-1 講完）
4. 兩個漏洞的攻擊條件不同——被動竊聽需要攻擊者在網路路徑上；假冒 Node ID 完全不需要在路徑上，只要能取得一個被允許的身分就能直接抓到私有 repo。（post 順序：此點在 H2-3 展開）
5. 官方自己畫的安全邊界：Git object 與 Signed References 的完整性驗證仍然有效，攻擊者讀得到內容，但沒辦法偽造程式碼或身分。
6. 沒有版本協商機制，讓修復沒辦法向下相容，只能整個換成 iroh，版號會跳大版本，升級與未升級的節點會分裂成互不相通的兩群。
7. 修復版本釋出前，官方建議完全停用私有 repo 的網路功能，並把任何曾經透過網路傳輸過的私有 repo 當作已經外洩處理。

perspective.mechanism: 官方揭露文件把兩個獨立漏洞攤開——傳輸層沒加密沒認證，加上 handshake 的身分驗證是假的，兩者疊加讓攻擊者能在路徑上讀取私有 repo，或直接假冒被允許的 Node ID 繞過存取控制；但 Git object 與 Signed References 的完整性驗證仍然有效，攻擊者讀得到內容但無法偽造。
perspective.tradeoff: 沒有版本協商機制，讓官方沒辦法只補一個安全性 patch，只能整個換掉底層傳輸協定成 iroh，代價是 breaking release、新舊節點網路分裂成兩群互不相通。
perspective.reader_use: 如果你有在網路上傳輸過私有 repo，修復版本發布前應假設內容已外洩，並用 rad block 等指令停止繼續透過網路分享私有 repo。

perspective.mechanism: 研究者從封包截取直接證實 handshake 完成後緊接著就是明文的協定資料，並在 radicle-node 的程式碼裡指出根因：Noise handshake 完成跟 SOCKS5 proxy 協商完成共用同一個 is_complete() 判斷式，導致該加密的資料被當成明文直接穿透。
perspective.tradeoff: 研究者的揭露節奏（回報後大約三個月才公開）反映的是協調揭露的取捨——給廠商足夠時間修復，但也代表漏洞在這段時間裡持續影響所有正式節點。
perspective.reader_use: 工程師可以用同樣的封包截取手法（檢查 handshake 完成後的第一個位元組是不是明文協定資料）驗證自己連線的節點是否還在用受影響的版本。

perspective.mechanism: issue 裡貼出的程式碼片段顯示同一個 is_complete() 條件同時出現在 read 跟 write 路徑，兩邊都會在該條件成立時繞過 Noise 的加解密，直接讀寫底層 TCP session。
perspective.tradeoff: 這個 issue 開在 cyphernet-labs/netservices.rs——Radicle 依賴的底層函式庫倉庫，不是 Radicle 自己的 repo，代表修復需要跨專案協調，這也是官方選擇整個換成 iroh 而不是在原函式庫上打補丁的部分背景。
perspective.reader_use: 任何使用同一個 netservices.rs／cyphernet.rs 函式庫的其他專案，都該檢查自己是不是有同樣的 is_complete() 誤用模式。

notes.quote: All versions of Radicle that were released to date are vulnerable.
notes.interpretation: 官方明確表示目前為止所有已發布版本都受影響，還沒有任何一個已發布版本是安全的。

notes.quote: Network traffic between nodes is not encrypted and not authenticated.
notes.interpretation: 核心設計缺陷——節點間傳輸本來就沒有做到該有的機密性與身份驗證。

notes.quote: This was reported to us by Konstantinos Maninakis on 2026-06-24.
notes.interpretation: 第一個漏洞（明文傳輸）由這位研究者於 6 月 24 日呈報。

notes.quote: This was reported to us by cryptocode on 2026-08-12.
notes.interpretation: 第二個漏洞（handshake 身分冒充）由另一位研究者在 8 月 12 日呈報，比第一個晚了將近兩個月，兩者是各自獨立回報的問題。

notes.quote: An attacker can connect to your node and present a Node ID that is not its own.
notes.interpretation: Handshake 沒有真正驗證對方聲稱的 Node ID，任何人都能假冒身分連進來。

notes.quote: Private repositories are shared only with allow-listed Node IDs.
notes.interpretation: 私有 repo 的存取控制完全建立在「這個 Node ID 是不是在名單上」，沒有其他驗證層。

notes.quote: An attacker who fakes an allow-listed Node ID can fetch a private repository directly, without being on the network path.
notes.interpretation: 關鍵細節——第二個漏洞不需要攻擊者在網路路徑中間，只要能取得或猜到被允許的 Node ID 就能直接假冒身分抓 repo，跟第一個漏洞（被動竊聽）是不同的攻擊面與不同的前提條件。

notes.quote: Due to a lack of version negotiation features, combined with the fix being incompatible on the wire, a backward compatible mitigation is not feasible; that means the release to fix this issue will be breaking, thus bump the major version number. Work towards this is under way.
notes.interpretation: 沒有版本協商機制，代表沒辦法讓新舊節點在同一個網路裡優雅並存，修復必須是 breaking release，版號要跳大版本；官方用「under way」表示修復還在進行中，沒有給出明確時程。

notes.quote: We recommend to stop using private repositories until a fix is released.
notes.interpretation: 官方建議是修復版本釋出前，完全停用私有 repo 的網路傳輸功能。

notes.quote: The resolution involves replacing Radicle's networking protocol (currently a custom protocol using Noise) with iroh, an open source peer-to-peer networking stack built on open standards.
notes.interpretation: 現行協定是自製、以 Noise 為基礎的協定；解法不是修補現有協定，而是整個換成 iroh。

notes.quote: Such a change to the network transport is by its nature backwards-incompatible. As such, it causes the network to partition into the upgraded and non-upgraded clusters that can not communicate with each other.
notes.interpretation: 換協定後，新舊節點會分裂成兩個互不相通的網路，這是官方自己點名的 backwards-incompatible 的實際後果。（校正：原本記的引文是意譯後的名詞化版本「network partitioning into...」，這裡改回逐字動詞版本，避免正文引用時跟原文不符。）

notes.quote: The main concern is information leakage, i.e., attackers along the network path between two nodes reading objects in transit.
notes.interpretation: 官方自己把主要風險定位為資訊外洩，而不是竄改或偽造。

notes.quote: For public repositories, information leakage is less of a concern. However, encryption in transit is crucial for private repositories.
notes.interpretation: 公開 repo 受影響有限（反正內容本來就公開），真正受害的是私有 repo。

notes.quote: An attacker cannot forge code or identities.
notes.interpretation: 即使傳輸層被攻破，Git object 與 Signed References 的完整性驗證仍然擋住偽造——這是這次漏洞明確劃出的安全邊界。

notes.quote: Two critical security vulnerabilities in the network protocol used by Radicle nodes were reported.
notes.interpretation: 官方自己把這兩個漏洞定調為 critical。

notes.quote: We would like to thank Konstantinos Maninakis and cryptocode for responsibly disclosing these vulnerabilities to us and staying in touch.
notes.interpretation: 確認這是一次標準的協調揭露流程——兩位研究者分別回報，團隊在公開時致謝。

notes.quote: Consider every private repository you have transmitted over the network to another node leaked.
notes.interpretation: 官方給出非常直白的假設——只要曾經透過網路傳輸過的私有 repo，就該當作已經外洩處理，不是理論風險。

notes.quote: rad ls --private --all / rad block <RID> / rad node stop
notes.interpretation: 官方在「如何停止散布私有 repo」段落給出的具體操作步驟：先列出私有 repo，逐一 block，必要時直接停節點。這是修復版本釋出前唯一能做的手動應變。

notes.quote: the first inbound byte after the handshake, offset 32 of a live connection to a production seed, is the ASCII `r` of `rad`.
notes.interpretation: 研究者從封包截取直接觀察到的證據——handshake 做完後，第一個位元組就是明文的 Radicle 協定開頭，證明加密根本沒有生效。

notes.quote: Same wrapper, same `is_complete()`, opposite meaning.
notes.interpretation: 研究者指出根本原因：程式碼把「Noise handshake 完成」跟「SOCKS5 proxy 協商完成」這兩種語意不同的完成狀態共用同一個 is_complete() 判斷式，導致該加密的資料被當成已經協商完的 proxy 資料直接明文穿透。

notes.quote: commits with author identity, timestamps and SSH signatures intact
notes.interpretation: 研究者截取到的明文封包裡，git pack data 帶著完整的作者身分、時間戳與簽章資訊，具體證實「讀得到內容」不是抽象說法。

notes.quote: If you have fetched, or still fetch, or seeded to others, a private repository over clearnet, treat its contents as having been exposed to public eyes.
notes.interpretation: 研究者自己給的影響評估跟官方口徑一致——只要走過明文網路，就該當作已經外洩。

notes.quote: a roughly three-month embargo
notes.interpretation: 研究者自述雙方協議大約三個月的揭露緩衝期，對應 6 月 24 日回報到 9 月 23 日公開的時間差。

notes.quote: if self.state.is_complete() || !self.session.is_established() { return self.session.read(buf); }
notes.interpretation: GitHub issue 裡貼出的程式碼片段，顯示 read 路徑在滿足這個條件時直接繞過 Noise 加解密，回退到底層 TCP session 的明文讀寫；issue 說明同樣的模式也出現在 write 路徑。

notes.quote: `agent=radicle-fetch/0.21.1` … `PACK.........%x..P`
notes.interpretation: 研究者在封包截取裡直接讀到的兩段明文字串，一段是 client 版本字串、一段是 git pack data 的開頭，作為「流量沒加密」這個結論的具體佐證，不是抽象推測。

notes.quote: A successful handshake therefore does not imply that subsequent messages are encrypted and authenticated.
notes.interpretation: issue 本文把根因講得比官方揭露文件更直白：handshake 成功這件事本身，並不保證後續訊息真的有被加密與驗證——這正是 is_complete() 誤用造成的邏輯落差。

notes.quote: Encrypt and decrypt writes and reads. Keep passthrough behavior for protocols that only negotiate a connection, such as SOCKS5.
notes.interpretation: issue 提出的第一個修法方向：把「加解密」跟「SOCKS5 這類只協商連線本身的協定的穿透行為」分開處理，不要共用同一個判斷式。

notes.quote: Define transport framing over byte streams. Noise requires applications to supply any needed length fields; its specification recommends a two-byte big-endian message length.
notes.interpretation: issue 提出的第二個修法方向：額外定義訊息長度欄位（Noise 規格建議兩位元組 big-endian），把訊息邊界跟位元組流分開。

notes.quote: Created: September 23, 2026 · Status: Open · Reporter: lorenzleutgeb (with acknowledgment to @maninak)
notes.interpretation: issue metadata：建立日期跟官方公開揭露同一天，回報者帳號是 lorenzleutgeb 並在內文感謝 @maninak；截至公開當天沒有對應的 pull request，狀態是 open。

notes.quote: I put Wireshark on the connection to see what the other side was actually sending me.
notes.interpretation: 研究者用來截包的工具是 Wireshark——一般網路工程師常備的工具，不是特製設備。

notes.quote: From byte 32 on nothing is encrypted.
notes.interpretation: 研究者對截包結果最直接的總結句：handshake 之後的第 32 個位元組開始，完全沒有加密，跟另一則筆記裡「第一個位元組是明文的 r」對應同一個觀察。

notes.quote: did what Noise says and encrypted everything past the peer-to-peer handshake
notes.interpretation: 研究者自己在 Grove 裡實作的 Noise 傳輸層是正確的、照規格加密；問題出在正式 Radicle 節點那一端沒有照做，形成對照。

notes.quote: rewriting it in TypeScript, byte for byte
notes.interpretation: Grove 的 Noise 實作是研究者把 Rust 版 heartwood 原始碼逐位元組搬到 TypeScript 得到的，理論上該與任何遵守同規格的節點握手成功。

notes.quote: Konstantinos Maninakis, a software engineer busy with peer-to-peer and Web-native systems
notes.interpretation: 研究者的自我介紹／作者簡介，用於文末的作者背景說明。

notes.quote: Beyond addressing the vulnerabilities, iroh brings additional features like NAT traversal which improve the reliability and resilience of the Radicle network.
notes.interpretation: 官方自己給的理由不只是修漏洞——換成 iroh 順便帶來 NAT traversal 之類的功能，對整個網路的可靠度與韌性也有幫助。

notes.quote: Both flaws are in the node transport layer, not in the repository data model.
notes.interpretation: 官方自己對「What is affected」的定位：兩個漏洞都在節點的傳輸層，不在 repository 的資料模型裡——跟 Git object／Signed References 完整性沒被打穿是同一件事的兩種講法。

notes.quote: With SOCKS5 this is exactly what the spec asks for. Once the proxy handshake is done, you get out of the way and pass the bytes through as they are. With Noise, the end of the handshake is where the real work starts, because from then on you encrypt everything. Same wrapper, same `is_complete()`, opposite meaning. Only the SOCKS5 half of that ever got implemented.
notes.interpretation: 研究者對根因最完整的說法：SOCKS5 規格本來就要求 handshake 一完成就放行明文；Noise 規格則相反，handshake 完成後才是加密真正開始的地方。同一個 wrapper 套用兩種協定，卻只實作了 SOCKS5 那一半的行為。

notes.quote: Whichever way you fix it, the wire changes. Every message gets 16 bytes longer, anything big gets chopped into pieces, and every piece needs a length header in front of it... an unfixed node reading a fixed node's stream sees garbage, and vice versa. It's a breaking change to the Radicle protocol, and that's why the fix ended up being a whole 2.0.
notes.interpretation: 研究者自己對修法後果的推算：不管怎麼修，線上格式都會變（訊息變長、需要切片、需要長度前綴），新舊節點互讀對方的位元組流會變成亂碼；這是研究者自己對「會是 2.0」的判斷，官方揭露文件本身只說『bump major version number』，沒有點名確切版號，所以正文引用『2.0』時會標明是研究者的說法。

notes.quote: A `rad clone` of one of my own repositories, from my node to my seed, with `tcpdump` on the interface: 1,522 packets. The inbound stream is 3.6 MB and opens with the same `72 61 64 01`. About two thirds in, Git starts talking
notes.interpretation: 研究者用 tcpdump 截的另一次 repo clone：1,522 個封包、進站流量 3.6 MB，開頭一樣是明文的 72 61 64 01（即 rad 的 ASCII），約三分之二之後開始出現 Git 協定的交談。（校正：原本這條筆記是轉述摘要，不是逐字句子，已換成重新讀到的逐字段落。）

notes.quote: Grove, a Radicle node that runs inside a browser tab, on any device, with no server doing Git on its behalf.
notes.interpretation: Grove 的定位：一個跑在瀏覽器分頁裡、在任何裝置上都能跑、沒有伺服器代為執行 Git 操作的 Radicle 節點——不是「不用裝用戶端軟體」這個說法，是「沒有伺服器代勞」。

notes.quote: one of the Radicle team's production seeds
notes.interpretation: iris.radicle.network 的身分只到「Radicle 團隊的一個 production seed」，來源沒有進一步講這是不是官方直接維運的基礎設施，正文不應該加碼講成「官方自己基礎設施」。

notes.quote: We reported upstream, see this issue.
notes.interpretation: 官方揭露文件自己點名了上游那個 GitHub issue，確認 cyphernet-labs/netservices.rs 那份 issue 是官方通報上游的結果，不是我自己推論兩者有關聯。

notes.quote: We already shared out plans to migrate, and the vulnerabilities have given us all the more reason to move forward with this.
notes.interpretation: 換成 iroh 不是這次漏洞才臨時決定的：官方原本就已經公開分享過遷移計畫，這兩個漏洞只是多了一個往前推進的理由，不是「上游函式庫這一層修法就夠、但官方選了別的路」這種對比框架。

notes.quote: the three addresses it wants to be reached on (a DNS name, an I2P address and a Tor onion)
notes.interpretation: 封包裡明文宣告的是三種位址：DNS 名稱、I2P 位址、Tor onion 位址——是「位址」不是「身分」，也不是只有 DNS 跟 I2P 兩種。

notes.quote: That was gossip: routing metadata, repository ids, node addresses.
notes.interpretation: 研究者自己對「gossip 資料」的定義：路由中繼資料、repository id、節點位址，這三類東西構成他說的 gossip。

notes.quote: I take contract work on systems design, web applications and developer tooling
notes.interpretation: 作者簡介裡接案範圍的逐字清單：系統設計、網頁應用、開發工具三類。

notes.quote: The second flaw is harder to exploit on its own than it sounds. To impersonate an allow-listed Node ID, an attacker must first know one. The allow-list is not public, so an attacker who is not on the network path has to guess.
notes.interpretation: 官方自己替第二個漏洞加了一個重要限定：單獨拿出來看，這個漏洞比聽起來難用——攻擊者得先知道一個被允許的 Node ID；允許清單不公開，不在路徑上的攻擊者只能用猜的。這條限定原本被我的正文省略了，容易讓讀者以為冒充完全沒有門檻。

notes.quote: The realistic threat is anyone on the path between your node and node it syncs with, and no setting or allow-list protects against them.
notes.interpretation: 官方自己講的「現實威脅」畫像：真正該擔心的是那個本來就站在你節點跟同步對象之間路徑上的人——沒有任何設定或允許清單擋得住這種人。兩個漏洞疊在一起看，威脅最大的組合還是「在路徑上」這個條件。

notes.quote: Noise ciphertext messages are limited to 65535 bytes, including the authentication tag (which is 16 bytes long).
notes.interpretation: issue 裡對「訊息變長 16 bytes」的具體出處：Noise 的密文訊息上限是 65535 bytes，其中包含 16 bytes 長的驗證標籤（authentication tag）。

notes.quote: we are working to make the upgrade path as smooth as possible, by focusing breakage on the network end, keeping storage layout compatible.
notes.interpretation: 官方講的是目標／努力方向（working to），不是已經完成或保證的結果——把破壞侷限在網路端、儲存格式盡量維持相容，是意圖，不是承諾。正文引用時必須保留這個意圖語氣，不能寫成「不需要重新驗證或搬遷」這種確定語氣。

notes.quote: We are publishing this before the security update is available. You can act on it today, and no fix we release later can undo an exposure that has already happened.
notes.interpretation: 官方自己講的公開時機邏輯：先公開、修復還沒出來，因為使用者今天就能採取行動，而事後的修復沒辦法撤銷已經發生的外洩。這是官方給的「為什麼現在公開」的理由，不是「等兩份回報都收齊、修法方向確定才公開」這種我自己編的節奏敘述。

notes.quote: Peer authentication in the connection handshake is broken and allows impersonation.
notes.interpretation: Official one-line statement of the second flaw; quoted verbatim in H2-3 para 1.

claims.claim_text: 連上一個正式的 Radicle seed 節點，Noise handshake 明明做完了，緊接著進來的第一個位元組，卻是明文的「r」，rad 這個字的開頭。
claims.evidence: The first inbound byte after the handshake, offset 32 of a live connection to a production seed, is the ASCII `r` of `rad`.

claims.claim_text: 這是 Radicle 專案在 2026 年 9 月 23 日公開的一次協調揭露。官方自己把兩個漏洞定調為 critical
claims.evidence: 23.09.2026 … Two critical security vulnerabilities in the network protocol used by Radicle nodes were reported.

claims.claim_text: 目前為止所有已發布版本都受影響，沒有一個版本是安全的
claims.evidence: All versions of Radicle that were released to date are vulnerable.
claims.note: Volatile; disclosure dated one day before the post.

claims.claim_text: 「From byte 32 on nothing is encrypted.」……「did what Noise says and encrypted everything past the peer-to-peer handshake」
claims.evidence: From byte 32 on nothing is encrypted: anyone on the network path can read all of it. … My first transport implementation did what Noise says and encrypted everything past the peer-to-peer handshake.

claims.claim_text: 一個判斷式把 Noise handshake 已完成與 SOCKS5 代理協商已完成共用了同一個 is_complete() 條件
claims.evidence: Same wrapper, same `is_complete()`, opposite meaning. (blog); if self.state.is_complete() || !self.session.is_established() { … return self.session.read(buf); } (issue)
claims.note: Issue author reproduced it after Maninakis reported; both trace to one discoverer.

claims.claim_text: Maninakis 寫道：「With SOCKS5 this is exactly what the spec asks for. … Same wrapper, same is_complete(), opposite meaning. Only the SOCKS5 half of that ever got implemented.」
claims.evidence: With SOCKS5 this is exactly what the spec asks for. Once the proxy handshake is done, you get out of the way and pass the bytes through as they are. With Noise, the end of the handshake is where the real work starts, because from then on you encrypt everything. Same wrapper, same `is_complete()`, opposite meaning. Only the SOCKS5 half of that ever got implemented.
claims.note: Round 1: sentence silently dropped. Round 2: restored.

claims.claim_text: GitHub issue 開在 cyphernet-labs/netservices.rs——Radicle 依賴的底層函式庫；官方揭露文件也寫明「We reported upstream, see this issue」
claims.evidence: We reported upstream, see [this issue](https://github.com/cyphernet-labs/netservices.rs/issues/48).
claims.note: Round 1 trace gap. Round 2: note n42 added.

claims.claim_text: issue 建立於 9 月 23 日，回報者是 lorenzleutgeb，內文點名感謝 Maninakis；截至公開當天還是 open 狀態，沒有對應的 pull request
claims.evidence: I would like to acknowledge that @maninak reported this issue to me, I am reporting it here after reproducing it myself. (issue page: author lorenzleutgeb, created September 23, 2026, status Open, no linked pull requests)
claims.note: Volatile status, dated in text.

claims.claim_text: issue 寫道：「A successful handshake therefore does not imply that subsequent messages are encrypted and authenticated.」
claims.evidence: A successful handshake therefore does not imply that subsequent messages are encrypted and authenticated.

claims.claim_text: if self.state.is_complete() || !self.session.is_established() { return self.session.read(buf); }——這個條件同時出現在讀跟寫兩條路徑上
claims.evidence: if self.state.is_complete() || !self.session.is_established() { … return self.session.read(buf); } … (and the same guard with return self.session.write(buf);)
claims.note: Log lines dropped; trivial reformat.

claims.claim_text: issue 提了兩個修法方向：「Encrypt and decrypt writes and reads. …」與「Define transport framing over byte streams. …」
claims.evidence: Encrypt and decrypt writes and reads. Keep passthrough behavior for protocols that only negotiate a connection, such as SOCKS5. / Define transport framing over byte streams. Noise requires applications to supply any needed length fields; its specification recommends a two-byte big-endian message length.

claims.claim_text: 這次換底層並不是臨時起意的替代方案——官方自己寫道：「We already shared out plans to migrate, and the vulnerabilities have given us all the more reason to move forward with this」

claims.claim_text: 「The main concern is information leakage, i.e., attackers along the network path between two nodes reading objects in transit」
claims.evidence: Thus, the main concern is information leakage, i.e., attackers along the network path between two nodes reading objects in transit.

claims.claim_text: 這種暴露大概不容易留下痕跡……可能也起不了作用
claims.note: Marked with 大概/可能.

claims.claim_text: 「For public repositories, information leakage is less of a concern. However, encryption in transit is crucial for private repositories」
claims.evidence: For public repositories, information leakage is less of a concern. However, encryption in transit is crucial for private repositories.

claims.claim_text: 「An attacker cannot forge code or identities」。Git object 與 Signed References 的完整性驗證沒有被打穿
claims.evidence: Both flaws are in the node transport layer, not in the repository data model. Git objects and signed references are verified at the storage layer as before. An attacker cannot forge code or identities.

claims.claim_text: 「Private repositories are shared only with allow-listed Node IDs」…「An attacker can connect to your node and present a Node ID that is not its own」…「An attacker who fakes an allow-listed Node ID can fetch a private repository directly, without being on the network path」
claims.evidence: An attacker can connect to your node and present a Node ID that is not its own. Private repositories are shared only with allow-listed Node IDs. An attacker who fakes an allow-listed Node ID can fetch a private repository directly, without being on the network path.

claims.claim_text: 這條路不需要攻擊者卡在網路中間，但官方自己也替它加了一個限定：「The second flaw is harder to exploit on its own than it sounds. … has to guess」
claims.evidence: The second flaw is harder to exploit on its own than it sounds. To impersonate an allow-listed Node ID, an attacker must first know one. The allow-list is not public, so an attacker who is not on the network path has to guess.
claims.note: Round 1: hedge inflated by omission. Round 2: official qualifier restored in all three places.

claims.claim_text: 「Beyond addressing the vulnerabilities, iroh brings additional features like NAT traversal …」
claims.evidence: Beyond addressing the vulnerabilities, iroh brings additional features like NAT traversal which improve the reliability and resilience of the Radicle network.

claims.claim_text: 「Due to a lack of version negotiation features, combined with the fix being incompatible on the wire, a backward compatible mitigation is not feasible; … Work towards this is under way」
claims.evidence: Due to a lack of version negotiation features, combined with the fix being incompatible on the wire, a backward compatible mitigation is not feasible; that means the release to fix this issue will be breaking, thus bump the major version number. Work towards this is under way.
